# Flower Power Pizza Ranong

> The premier authentic Italian pizzeria, fresh artisan pasta, and restaurant in Ranong, Thailand. Located in a scenic tropical oasis with a private natural waterfall, pond, indoor hall, outdoor dining, and traditional garden huts.

## Quick Facts
- **Cuisine**: 100% Authentic Italian, Artisan Pizza (Red, White & Special Pizzas), Homemade Fresh Pasta, Artisan Italian Sausage, Focaccia, Italian Coffee, Fresh Fruit Shakes, Curated Fine Wines, and periodic Chef Specials.
- **Flour & Ingredients**: 100% Imported Italian flour, natural 48-hour dough maturation, San Marzano style tomato sauce, premium Fior di Latte mozzarella, extra virgin olive oil.
- **Location**: 129/6 Moo 1, Tambon Bang Rin, Mueang Ranong, Ranong 85000, Thailand (Near Raksawarin Hot Springs).
- **Ambience & Setting**: Enchanting location surrounded by lush tropical greenery featuring a private natural waterfall, scenic pond, spacious indoor hall, breezy outdoor terrace, and traditional private garden huts (capanne).
- **Opening Hours**: Daily 11:00 – 21:30 (Kitchen & Delivery).
- **Services**: Dine-in, Takeaway, Fast Home & Hotel Delivery across Ranong.
- **Delivery Policy**: Flat 30 THB delivery across Ranong / FREE delivery on orders over 300 THB.
- **Phone**: +66 94 980 0200 / +66 85 884 4852
- **Official Website & Online Orders**: [https://www.flowerpowerpizza.com](https://www.flowerpowerpizza.com)
- **Welcome Promotion**: 10% discount on first online order + dynamic promo coupon codes.

## Key Offerings & Specialties
- **Pizze Rosse (Classic Red Pizzas)**: Margherita, Marinara, Diavola (Spicy Salami), Prosciutto e Funghi, Capricciosa, Quattro Stagioni, Napoli, and more.
- **Pizze Bianche (White Pizzas)**: Quattro Formaggi, Primavera, Tartufo, Panna e Funghi, Gorgonzola e Noci.
- **Pizze Speciali & Gourmet**: Unique handcrafted recipes with gourmet toppings, artisan burrata, and Italian delicacies.
- **Artisan Focacce**: Hand-kneaded focaccia with rosemary, extra virgin olive oil, sea salt, or prosciutto crudo.
- **Homemade Fresh Pasta (Pasta Fresca Fatta in Casa)**: Handcrafted Italian pasta prepared with traditional Italian techniques and authentic sauces (Bolognese, Carbonara, Pesto, Arrabbiata, Pomodoro e Basilico).
- **Artisan Italian Sausage (Salsiccia Artigianale)**: Prepared and seasoned in-house following authentic Italian butcher recipes.
- **Periodic Chef Specials (Piatti Speciali)**: Rotating seasonal dishes inspired by regional Italian gastronomy.
- **Italian Cafeteria & Espresso Bar**: Authentic Italian espresso, cappuccino, caffe latte, and cold brews.
- **Fresh Tropical Fruit Shakes**: 100% natural mango, watermelon, pineapple, passion fruit, and lime shakes.
- **Curated Wine Collection**: Hand-selected Italian and international wines pairing with pizza and pasta.
